parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for human single-protein target CHEMBL1681631 (Acyl-protein thioesterase 1). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
